title: Inlet Beach "High Tide" 28 Tidewater Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance to the beach- Private salt water Martini pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $25 per day.- 3 adult bikes- Grill- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Sink into serenity at High Tide, a beautiful 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom Inlet Beach home, sleeping up to 8 guests—only a 4-minute walk from beach access. Tucked beside Camp Helen State Park, this quiet stretch of 30A is a perfect coastal haven. Savor fresh pastries from the Donut Hole, souvenir-browse at the Inlet Beach Shoppes, sunbathe on the beach, or rent a paddleboard and enjoy an afternoon snorkeling around the Grouper Reef while discovering the marine wildlife! When not exploring the area, guests will love relaxing in the private heated Martini pool or in the ample outdoor space.Step inside this 2-level home to discover a carefully curated interior of warm neutrals, golden tones, and natural light, creating a zen atmosphere for peaceful unwinding and slow-paced days. The fully equipped kitchen, with its modern aesthetics, open layout, and eat-in island for 4, seamlessly connects the living and dining spaces for effortless gathering. Split a bottle of wine over a hearty dinner at the banquette-style dining table for 6, before effortlessly moving to the comfortable couch or stylish lounge chair to stream a movie on the Smart TV. Through the glass doors, a covered patio and courtyard invite guests to take advantage of the Gulf weather. Refresh with a dip in the saltwater pool, barbecue on the propane grill, dine alfresco at the 6-seat table, or recline on the cushioned seating as a wide umbrella provides luxurious shade. When night falls, guests can retire to the primary bedroom’s plush king bed and private bathroom. A washer and dryer in the kitchen closet make it a breeze to refresh swimwear or towels after a day of in-the-water fun.On the second-level landing, 2 twin beds offer additional sleeping accommodations, and a back door leads to a rooftop balcony and lanai living area with a TV. This floor also features a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, as well as a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds.With the beach a short walk away, a private cocktail pool, and secluded outdoor spaces, High Tide has everything guests need for a fantastic Inlet Beach getaway—including parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes. To reach the beach, head out theback gate, follow Park Place, turn left onto South Walton Lakeshore Drive, and follow the road to Phillips Inlet Beach Access. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds - Additional Sleeping Area: 2 Twin Beds on Landing*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
